answers.sharpe_calmar_and_cagr_answer: Yes. `lb20_stop3.2_trail5.0_beoff` improved CAGR, Sharpe, and Calmar versus the prior research_optimal, then passed the full non-baseline Gatekeeper V2 stack. That is enough to upgrade it as the new research_optimal, even though it is still not a launch-approved configuration.
answers.baseline_gate_answer: The evidence is now explicit: at 100% sizing baseline_gate still fails for more than just trade count because MaxDD remains below the -30% cap; at 35% sizing the main remaining blocker is the legacy 250-trade threshold, which does not fit a low-frequency trend mother. This is not a system-safety or stress-test failure.

decision.decision_note: Upgrade `lb20_stop3.2_trail5.0_beoff` to the new research_optimal. Keep launch_optimal at LAUNCH_NO_GO because baseline_gate still fails, while all other Gatekeeper V2 checks continue to pass.
